goal: Converge the platform onto ADR-008 with trustworthy gates, one Agent kernel, one database authority, explicit service ownership and evidence-backed release behavior.
execution_model: Single writer in the current checkout. No new worktree. Docker, database, E2E and provider work were serialized; host Cargo is prohibited. No further subagents are planned for closeout.
last_result: 2026-08-30: core implementation, unit/integration gates and current-stack UI/Qwen/Knowledge/admin journeys passed. All services are healthy under the current checkout. Database baseline 2026_08_post_kb_v1 matches four fingerprints and 251 verification checks. The only Agent Studio code/test regression found was repaired and its 48-case route suite passed. Rollback stopped before mutation because the frozen image bundle is absent; hosted Rust CI/multi-arch, fresh-machine and one registry-dependent built-Nginx smoke remain unexecuted.
blockers: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_RUST_CI: no hosted fmt/check/changed-crate or multi-arch receipt for the tested SHA
BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_ARTIFACT: rollback bundle references three frozen image IDs that are absent and have no registry reference
NOT_RUN_FRESH_MACHINE: no separate fresh-machine registry pull/quickstart receipt was authorized or executed
BLOCKED_DOCKER_REGISTRY: built-Nginx smoke could not resolve the public Dockerfile frontend image; config contract and current Web build passed

phases.result: Fact and contract freeze, ADR and one program truth.
Trustworthy changed-path, CI, OpenAPI, boundary, hygiene and LOC gates.
Assistant Gateway API modularization with public contract parity.
Agent Runtime Gateway API split with stable seams and behavior.
Unified control/model launch, Capability V2 and no Gateway self-HTTP.
Rust Runtime/Worker HTTP boundaries with preserved live wire behavior.
Single migration authority, adopted baseline and per-service roles.
I/O-free contracts layer and bounded core compatibility shims.
Durable jobs, health/degradation, identity and trace closure.
Topology modes, singleton guards and admin architecture status.
Immutable release manifest, fresh environment and rollback closure.

features.description: Post-RAG facts/contracts are reproducible and reviewed.
Changed paths select real gates and required CI results fail closed.
Runtime artifacts have complete local and hosted identities.
Assistant facade preserves OpenAPI/SSE/errors and live behavior.
Runtime API surface is modular with stable seams.
All entrypoints use one launch contract with no self-HTTP.
Rust HTTP split has local live proof but requires hosted crate verification.
One migration authority converges supported database sources and roles.
Contracts are I/O-free and shims bounded.
Jobs, dependency health and traces explain terminal states.
Topology is guarded and visible to admins.
Release manifest binds fresh and rollback receipts.
